precedence.trigger_summary: company authority conflict, goal change, irreversible decision, promotion, or rollback
role-lead product, design, contract, requirements, scope, approval, same-cause-twice, unclear intent, or dynamic critical risk
initial unknown cause or security, data integrity, migration, lineage, rollback, concurrency, or performance risk
multi-module, critical-path, long-context, or approved retry; execution failure alone is insufficient
difficult long work that is clear, fully verifiable, credit-prioritized, and parallelizable
clear multi-file implementation using existing patterns
unconditional default for single-site, fixture, documentation, evidence, simple test, or repetitive work
